round2Why.text:
What changed in round 2 (from 9 commercial apps + Codex):
• Hero shows text landing in a real-looking app, with clickable Hold / Speak / Release steps
• Use-case tabs with a plain result caption each
• Setup preview before the data section; ‘Free. No account.’ card
• Engine card names the real models (Parakeet EN 477 MB; Qwen3-ASR for Hindi)
• Usage + error events: ON, disclosed on the very first setup screen with the switch, repeated at Finish
• Every step has Back/Continue; download runs in the background
• New board of failure states: download paused, permission needs relaunch, paste failed (words kept), Report a problem preview
• Dropped: ‘any length’, ‘about three minutes’, unverified claims
